newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec sets C$400 mln, 5.25 pct debenture due 2002.
newsitem.headline: Quebec sets C$400 mln, 5.25 pct debenture due 2002.

text.p: The Province of Quebec on Tuesday set a C$400 million, 5.25 percent debenture due April 1, 2002, said lead manager Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion.
The issue was priced at C$98.564 with an offering yield of 5.563 percent and a spread of 26 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.5 percent bond due April 1, 2002.
The debenture, which will be delivered on November 29, pays its first coupon on April 1, 1997.

The syndicate underwriting the Quebec issue includes Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, Merrill Lynch Canada Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc, and ScotiaMcLeod Inc.
